cells.name: 10Y Realized Volatility (20d, ann.)
cells.notes: Annualized realized volatility of daily 10-year Treasury yield changes over the trailing 20 sessions, in basis points. A real, free stand-in for the licensed ICE MOVE index: MOVE is option-implied (forward-looking) vol, this is realized (backward-looking) vol, so it confirms rather than leads, but both spike on the same shocks.
